mod_name: UMOPP - Universal Morrowind Official Plugins Patch
description: Comprehensive patch fixing mesh errors, script bugs, pathing, and dialogue inconsistencies across all 8 of Bethesda's official Morrowind plugins.

included_plugins.name: Bitter Coast Sounds
included_plugins.summary: Adds unique ambient sound effects (dragonflies, frogs, gulls) along the Bitter Coast region.
included_plugins.umopp_fixes: Fixes sound generator positions, script loops, and dialogue triggers.

included_plugins.name: Siege at Firemoth
included_plugins.summary: Send-off quest given by Mara in Seyda Neen to retake Fort Firemoth island from Griss the Lich and his undead horde.
included_plugins.umopp_fixes: Fixes follower AI navigation, skeleton respawns, Ward of Akavir shield stats, and boat transportation script.

included_plugins.name: Helm of Tohan
included_plugins.summary: Quest to track down the legendary Helm of Tohan in Onnissiralis or Sheogorad islands.
included_plugins.umopp_fixes: Corrects quest stage journal indices and enchantment charge attributes.

included_plugins.name: Master Index
included_plugins.summary: Quest given by Folms Mirel in Caldera Guild of Mages to collect all 10 Propylon Indices and forge the Master Propylon Index.
included_plugins.umopp_fixes: Fixes Master Index teleport destination coordinates and dialogue topic loops.

included_plugins.name: Leveled Magicka
included_plugins.summary: Recalculates maximum magicka pool dynamically based on Intelligence stat multipliers.
included_plugins.umopp_fixes: Eliminates magicka loss on load game and fortify attribute exploits.

included_plugins.name: Area Effect Arrows
included_plugins.summary: Adds elemental area-effect arrows sold by Aradraen in Vivec Foreign Quarter.
included_plugins.umopp_fixes: Fixes arrow collision meshes and shop inventory restock counters.

included_plugins.name: Entertainers
included_plugins.summary: Allows playing instruments, telling jokes, and dancing at Eight Plates tavern in Balmora.
included_plugins.umopp_fixes: Fixes tavern keeper payment calculations and lute animation timing.
